name: Beached Tanka boats with figures, pigs, and a cow and calf
summary:
Drawings by George Chinnery of beached Tanka boats raised up on large stones, with an added superstructure oven their bows; cattle and pigs appear alongside.
On the back is a pencil sketch of a seated figure by a Chinese grave.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
